say: So today at work my coworker Trác took credit for my slides in front of the whole team.
My manager yelled at me in the hallway today because HE forgot to send the invoice.
So this girl I was talking to for two weeks just ghosted me. Like completely, no reply.
Yesterday my landlord came into my apartment without knocking. Again. Third time this month.
In class today my groupmate didn't do anything for the project and then told the professor he did half of it.
You won't believe what my sister did at dinner. She announced she's quitting med school. At grandma's birthday.
So my best friend Duy and his girlfriend broke up today, out of nowhere, in the middle of the café.
Turns out my sensei used to be a national champion and he never told anyone. The whole dojo found out today.
Nobody showed up to my birthday dinner last night. I sat there for like an hour.
My friend Minh said I'm boring to hang out with. I felt so small.
So I visited my grandpa today and he didn't recognise me for a while.
Linh asked me out for coffee today! Out of nowhere!
At practice tonight I got a clean men on my senpai. First time ever. Everyone clapped.
My boss stopped by my desk today and said my report was the best one this quarter.
My friend tripped on stage during his graduation speech lol, and then he just kept going like nothing happened.
So I sat in the wrong lecture for forty minutes today before I realised. It was organic chemistry.
Okay so I kind of yelled at my roommate because she ate my leftovers.
